pairs.en: They wanted to remove the Divine Presence from the lower realms, so that the Name of Hashem would not be mentioned.
pairs.he: הם רצו לסלק השכינה מהתחתונים שלא יזכר שם ה'

pairs.en: "Come, let us build ourselves a city and a tower, etc., and let us make ourselves a name."
pairs.he: "הָבָה נִבְנֶה לָנוּ עִיר וּמִגְדָּל וְגוֹ' וְנַעֲשֶׂה לָנוּ שֵׁם"
(יא, ד)

pairs.en: All the builders of the tower denied faith in the creation of the world, from which all their errors arose (for even now all the great deniers are called by their name, P.M., as is known). And therefore they said, 'Come, let us build ourselves a city and a tower, with its top in the heavens,' for they are the opposite of all the above-mentioned rectifications through which one merits faith in the creation of the world. For they say, Come, let us build ourselves a city.
pairs.he: כָּל בּוֹנֵי הַמִּגְדָּל הָיוּ כּוֹפְרִים בֶּאֱמוּנַת חִדּוּשׁ הָעוֹלָם, שֶׁמִּשָּׁם הָיוּ כָּל טָעוּתֵיהֶם (אשר גם עתה כל הכופרים הגדולים נקראים על שמם פ"מ כידוע). וְעַל כֵּן אָמְרוּ 'הָבָה נִבְנֶה לָנוּ עִיר וּמִגְדָּל וְרֹאשׁוֹ בַשָּׁמַיִם', כִּי הֵם הַהֵפֶךְ מִכָּל הַתִּקּוּנִים הַנַּ"ל שֶׁעַל יְדֵי זֶה זוֹכִין לֶאֱמוּנַת חִדּוּשׁ הָעוֹלָם. כִּי הֵם אוֹמְרִים, הָבָה נִבְנֶה לָנוּ עִיר.

pairs.en: For this is one thing opposed to the other: they want to gather together and build a city out of their evil houses, out of the constructions of their evil views, until they want to make a tower with its top in the heavens—to build a lofty structure from their evil views until its top reaches the heavens, to rebel against the Omnipresent, to overturn the bowl on its mouth, Heaven forbid, and to deny the fundamental principle, as it is written there, "And the whole earth was one language and common words." And Rashi explained: they spoke sharp words, etc.; for all this is an aspect of denials of the creation of the world, as the discerning person understands.
pairs.he: כִּי אֶת זֶה לְעֻמַּת זֶה שֶׁרוֹצִים לְהִתְקַבֵּץ וְלִבְנוֹת עִיר מִבָּתִּים רָעִים שֶׁלָּהֶם מִבִּנְיְנֵי דֵּעוֹת רָעוֹת, שֶׁלָּהֶם עַד שֶׁרוֹצִים לַעֲשׂוֹת מִגְדָּל וְרֹאשׁוֹ בַשָּׁמַיִם לִבְנוֹת בִּנְיָן גָּבוֹהַּ מִדֵּעוֹת רָעוֹת שֶׁלָּהֶם עַד שֶׁיַּגִּיעַ רֹאשׁוֹ בַשָּׁמַיִם לִמְרֹד נֶגֶד הַמָּקוֹם לַהֲפֹךְ הַקְּעָרָה עַל פִּיהָ חַס וְשָׁלוֹם, וְלִכְפֹּר בָּעִקָּר, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב שָׁם "וַיְהִי כָּל הָאָרֶץ שָׂפָה אַחַת וּדְבָרִים אֲחָדִים". וּפֵרֵשׁ רש"י, וּדְבָרִים חַדִּים אָמְרוּ וְכוּ', שֶׁכָּל זֶה הוּא בְּחִינַת כְּפִירוֹת בְּחִדּוּשׁ הָעוֹלָם, כַּמּוּבָן לַמַּשְׂכִּיל.

pairs.en: For they certainly were not wholly mad and foolish in saying that they would wage war against the Creator, blessed be He. Rather, their entire intention was to wage war by their evil views, which they would construct there, against the true views of faith in the creation of the world, which introduce and establish in everyone's heart knowledge of His Divinity, blessed be He. And they wanted to remove His Divine Presence from the lower realms so that, Heaven forbid, the Name of Hashem would no longer be mentioned; for this was the entire inner evil intention of the builders of the tower who were then, and of all the deniers of the present time, who likewise are in the aspect of the builders of the tower. And as it is written, "Those who think to cause My Name to be forgotten, etc." And therefore they said, 'And let us make ourselves a name,' for they want to draw the name and the honor to themselves, for they impair the Name of Hashem, which is the aspect of His glory, blessed be He, as it is written, "Blessed be the Name of His glory forever," etc.
pairs.he: כִּי בְּוַדַּאי לֹא הָיוּ מְשֻׁגָּעִים וְטִפְּשִׁים גְּמוּרִים שֶׁאָמְרוּ שֶׁיַּעֲשׂוּ מִלְחָמָה עִם הַבּוֹרֵא יִתְבָּרַךְ, רַק כָּל כַּוָּנָתָם הָיָה שֶׁיַּעֲשׂוּ מִלְחָמָה בְּדֵעוֹתֵיהֶם הָרָעוֹת, שֶׁיִּבְנוּ שָׁם נֶגֶד הַדֵּעוֹת הָאֲמִתִּיּוֹת שֶׁל אֱמוּנַת חִדּוּשׁ הָעוֹלָם שֶׁהֵם מַכְנִיסִים וְקוֹבְעִים בְּלֵב כָּל אֶחָד יְדִיעַת אֱלֹקוּתוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ. וְהֵם רָצוּ לְסַלֵּק שְׁכִינָתוֹ מִן הַתַּחְתּוֹנִים שֶׁלֹּא יִזָּכֵר חַס וְשָׁלוֹם שֵׁם ה' עוֹד, שֶׁזֶּה כָּל פְּנִימִיַּת כַּוָּנָתָם הָרָעָה שֶׁל בּוֹנֵי הַמִּגְדָּל שֶׁהָיָה אָז וְשֶׁל כָּל הַכּוֹפְרִים שֶׁל עַכְשָׁו שֶׁהֵם גַּם כֵּן בִּבְחִינַת בּוֹנֵי הַמִּגְדָּל. וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב "הַחוֹשְׁבִים לְהַשְׁכִּיחַ אֶת שְׁמִי וְכוּ'". וְעַל כֵּן אָמְרוּ 'וְנַעֲשֶׂה לָנוּ שֵׁם', כִּי רוֹצִים לְהַמְשִׁיךְ הַשֵּׁם וְהַכָּבוֹד לְעַצְמוֹ, כִּי הֵם פּוֹגְמִים בְּשֵׁם ה', שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת כְּבוֹדוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב "יְבֹרַךְ שֵׁם כְּבוֹדוֹ לְעוֹלָם" וְכוּ'.

pairs.en: (Likutay Halachos, Laws of the Synagogue, Halacha 6, item 9)
pairs.he: (הלכות בית הכנסת הלכה ו' אות ט')

qualifications.text: The printed acronym פ"מ is retained as P.M.; its expansion is not supplied from inference.
The complete native crop supports the selected טָעוּתֵיהֶם. The earlier alternate cluster remains checkpoint history, not a current lexical hold.
'Creation of the world' renders חִדּוּשׁ הָעוֹלָם, its coming into being rather than its supposed eternity; the text's polemical denials are retained without softening.
'Common words' renders אֲחָדִים in the verse; 'sharp words' renders the printed interpretation חַדִּים, preserving the change of wording.

pairs.en: Holy souls were captured in places such as these.
pairs.he: נפשות קדושות נתפסו במקומות כאלו

pairs.en: "And Terach lived seventy years and fathered Avram."
pairs.he: "וַיְחִי תֶרַח שִׁבְעִים שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד אֶת אַבְרָם"
(יא, כו)

pairs.en: In the aspect of the chambers of exchanges, through the sin of the first man, Adam, very, very holy and precious souls were captured; these are in the aspect of the soul of Avraham, who because of this was compelled to come forth from Terach. And likewise the souls of several lofty and awesome tzaddikim, etc., as brought in the writings. And this is the aspect of the soul of Dovid, who is the aspect of Mashiach, which was also captured there. And against him they prevailed exceedingly, exceedingly, without measure. And therefore the Holy One, blessed be He, brought about many turnings until He drew his soul out from there by way of theft and cunning, for it is written, "With the crooked you shall act tortuously," as this secret is explained in the writings of the Ari. Because of this, the soul of Dovid was compelled first to come forth through the daughters of Lot, through such an unusual act and strange affair. And likewise the matter of Yehudah and Tamar, etc., etc.; for all this was to draw out his soul by way of theft from the Other Side, which had seized it and did not want to permit it to emerge except by way of theft, as explained in the writings. See Likutay Torah on Iyov, and in several other places.
pairs.he: בִּבְחִינַת הֵיכְלֵי הַתְּמוּרוֹת נִתְפְּסוּ עַל יְדֵי חֵטְא אָדָם הָרִאשׁוֹן נְפָשׁוֹת קְדוֹשׁוֹת וִיקָרוֹת מְאֹד מְאֹד, שֶׁהֵם בְּחִינַת נֶפֶשׁ אַבְרָהָם שֶׁמֵּחֲמַת זֶה הֻכְרַח לָצֵאת מִתֶּרַח. וְכֵן נַפְשׁוֹת כַּמָּה צַדִּיקִים גְּבוֹהִים וְנוֹרָאִים וְכוּ', כַּמּוּבָא בַּכְּתָבִים. וְזֶה בְּחִינַת נֶפֶשׁ דָּוִד שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת מָשִׁיחַ שֶׁנִּתְפְּסָה שָׁם גַּם כֵּן. וְעָלָיו הִתְגַּבְּרוּ בְּיוֹתֵר בְּיוֹתֵר בְּלִי שִׁעוּר. וְעַל כֵּן כַּמָּה גִּלְגּוּלִין עָבִיד קֻדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא עַד שֶׁהוֹצִיא נַפְשׁוֹ מִשָּׁם בְּדֶרֶךְ גְּנֵבָה וְעָרְמָה, כִּי עִם עִקֵּשׁ תִּתְפַּתָּל כְּתִיב, כַּמְבֹאָר זֶה הַסּוֹד בְּכִתְבֵי הָאֲרִ"י. שֶׁמֵּחֲמַת זֶה הֻכְרְחָה נֶפֶשׁ דָּוִד לָצֵאת תְּחִלָּה עַל יְדֵי בְּנוֹת לוֹט עַל יְדֵי מעש מְשֻׁנָּה וְדָבָר זָר כָּזֶה. וְכֵן עִנְיַן יְהוּדָה וְתָמָר וְכוּ' וְכוּ', שֶׁכָּל זֶה הָיָה לְהוֹצִיא נַפְשׁוֹ בְּדֶרֶךְ גְּנֵבָה מֵהַסִּטְרָא אַחֲרָא שֶׁעָשְׁקָה אוֹתָהּ וְלֹא רָצְתָה לְהַנִּיחַ לָצֵאת כִּי אִם בְּדֶרֶךְ גְּנֵבָה כַּמְבֹאָר בַּכְּתָבִים. עַיֵּן בְּלִקּוּטֵי תּוֹרָה עַל אִיּוֹב וְעוֹד בְּכַמָּה מְקוֹמוֹת.

pairs.en: (Likutay Halachos, Laws of the Morning Blessing, Halacha 3, item 4)
pairs.he: (הלכות ברכת השחר הלכה ג' אות ד')

qualifications.text: Note 55 is associated with this captured-souls teaching by its discussion of Avraham. The colored trace above the verse label has not been established as a printed raised נה; no raised marker is supplied.
The tiny vowel beneath the initial he of הֻכְרַח is provisional. The clause states the compulsion to come forth from Terach; no additional acting subject is supplied.

'Many turnings' renders the Aramaic כַּמָּה גִּלְגּוּלִין here, the divine circuitous means described by the ensuing events; it is not silently replaced by an account of multiple individual lifetimes.
'Chambers of exchanges' and 'the Other Side' retain the technical senses of היכלי התמורות and סטרא אחרא; the printing's full argument and repeated 'exceedingly' and 'etc.' are retained.
The printed noun מעש is defective and unpointed within the surrounding pointed body. It is retained without an added he or supplied vowels.

pairs.en: 55. The Ari, of blessed memory, wrote in Likutay Torah (at the beginning of the Book of Iyov):
pairs.he: נה. האריז"ל כתב בלקוטי תורה (בתחילת ספר איוב):

pairs.en: We have already explained that all the souls fell into the depths of the husk through the sin of the first man, Adam. And behold, when there is one precious soul within the husk, they do not permit that soul to emerge from under their hand, for they are nourished through [it]. When there is a precious soul among them there, they are nourished through it and do not permit it to emerge from there at all. Indeed, their intention is to defile it by everything within their power, so that it will always remain in their hand, for they fear that perhaps some person will have the merit to draw it out from there at the time of his marital union. Therefore, when they see some very greatly defective place, they put that soul there and permit it to emerge, so that it will become more corrupted than it was and return to them more defective than at first, so that it will remain in their hands for many days. And behold, guard this secret, for "It is the glory of God to conceal a matter." And know that Terach had intercourse with Amatlai while she was impure in her menstrual state. And then, when the husk saw this place of filth—that Terach worshipped idols and his wife likewise worshipped idols as he did, and not only this, but that she was then a woman in her menstrual state—the husk said, Certainly I shall not find a filthier place than this. And then it permitted the soul of Avraham to emerge from them, and it entered there, for the soul of Avraham had been among them, etc. And [he] found a place to draw out the soul of Avraham from the external forces, for the external forces would not be concerned about this matter, for, since it was entering such a filthy place. End of quotation.
pairs.he: כבר ביארנו שכל הנשמות נפלו בעמקי הקליפה ע"י חטא אדה"ר והנה כשיש נשמה א' יקרת הערך תוך הקליפה אינן מניחין אותה הנשמה לצאת מתחת ידם כי נזונים ע"י. כשיש נשמה יקרת הערך ביניהם שם הם ניזונים על ידה ואינם מניחים אותה לצאת משם כלל, האומנם כוונתם לטמאה בכל הבא בידם כדי שתשאר תמיד בידם, כי הם יראים אולי יהיה שם זכות באיזה אדם להוציאה משם בעת זיווגו. לכן כשרואים איזה מקום פגום עד מאד הם נותנין שם אותו הנשמה ומניחין לצאת כדי שתתקלקל ממה שהיתה ותחזור להם יותר פגומה מבראשונה כדי שתעמוד בידיהם ימים רבים והנה שמור סוד זה כי כבוד אלהים הסתר דבר. ודע כי תרח בעל אמתלאי בהיותה נדה טמאה ואז בראות הקליפ' מקום הטינוף זה שהוא תרח עובד ע"ז ואשתו ג"כ עע"ז כמוהו, ואל די בזה אלא שהיתה בעלת נדה אז, אמרה הקליפה ודאי שלא אמצא מקום מטונף יותר מזה ואז הניחה לצאת את נשמת אברהם מהם ונכנסה שם, כי נשמת אברהם ביניהן היתה וכו' ומצא מקום להוציא נשמת אברהם מן החיצונים כי לא יחושו החיצונים בדבר זה כי כיון שהיתה נכנסת במקום המטונף כזה. ע"כ.

qualifications.text: This printed note is preserved once with the captured-souls teaching, whose Likutay Torah on Iyov reference and subject matter correspond to the note. This is a contextual association; no raised printed note marker has been established.

The print ends the first nourishment clause with ע"י. without an expressed following noun or pronoun. '[it]' is supplied from the immediately repeated explanation that they are nourished through the soul.
The printed ומצא has no expressed subject in this excerpt. '[he]' preserves that grammatical gap without identifying the agent from outside the print.
The printed ending contains כי כיון ('for, since') and stops after במקום המטונף כזה ('in such a filthy place'). Its syntactic irregularity is preserved rather than completed with absent prose.
The note's assertions about menstrual impurity and idolatry are translated in full as source assertions; they are not softened or endorsed as independent historical facts.
Amatlai is a proposed conventional rendering of the unpointed printed אמתלאי; the scan supplies no vowels for this name.

pairs.en: "And Terach died in Charan."
pairs.he: "וַיָּמָת תֶּרַח בְּחָרָן"
(יא, לב)

pairs.en: And this is, 'And Hashem said to Avram, Go for yourself from your land and from your birthplace and from your father's house to the land,' etc.—namely, to the Land of Israel—which is placed next to the verse, 'And Terach died in Charan.' For Rashi explained there: Up to this point is the wrath of the Omnipresent.
pairs.he: וְזֶהוּ 'וַיֹּאמֶר ה' אֶל אַבְרָם לֶךְ לְךָ מֵאַרְצְךָ וּמִמּוֹלַדְתְּךָ וּמִבֵּית אָבִיךָ אֶל הָאָרֶץ' וְכוּ'. הַיְנוּ לְאֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל שֶׁנִּסְמַךְ לְפָסוּק 'וַיָּמָת תֶּרַח בְּחָרָן'. כִּי רש"י פֵּרֵשׁ שָׁם, עַד כָּאן חֲרוֹן אַף שֶׁל מָקוֹם.

pairs.en: And therefore, next to this is placed what Hashem, blessed be He, commanded Avraham: that he go to the Land of Israel, for through this he would sweeten and nullify the wrath. For through the Land of Israel one merits the aspect of patience, which is the opposite of wrath, as above. For Avraham is the head of the believers, and therefore he was the first to whom the holiness of the Land of Israel was revealed, as brought in the holy Zohar: he weighed in the balance until it was revealed to him. For the Land of Israel is the aspect of faith, the aspect of patience.
pairs.he: וְעַל כֵּן נִסְמַךְ לְזֶה מַה שֶׁצִּוָּהוּ הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ לְאַבְרָהָם שֶׁיֵּלֵךְ לְאֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל, כִּי עַל יְדֵי זֶה יַמְתִּיק וִיבַטֵּל הַחֲרוֹן אַף. כִּי עַל יְדֵי אֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל זוֹכִין לִבְחִינַת אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם. שֶׁהוּא הֵפֶךְ הַחֲרוֹן אַף כַּנַּ"ל. כִּי אַבְרָהָם רֹאשׁ לְמַאֲמִינִים וְעַל כֵּן הוּא הָיָה הָרִאשׁוֹן שֶׁנִּתְגַּלָּה לוֹ קְדֻשַּׁת אֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל, כַּמּוּבָא בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ תָּקִיל בְּתִקְלָא עַד דְּאִתְגַּלְי' לֵיהּ, כִּי אֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל הִיא בְּחִינַת אֱמוּנָה, בְּחִינַת אֲרִיכַת אַפַּיִם.
